note: Shared model registry for the frozen backbone. role: primary = used by both projects; robustness = the single second backbone both projects report; exploratory = available but outside course scope. Revisions, licences and architectures were read from the Hugging Face API on 2026-10-27. dtype is the recommended type on Apple Silicon. Engines never choose device, number type or attention themselves: every run names a runtime profile (below) and records it. A new entry may start with a null revision; python -m backbone.download --pin records it.

qwen2.5-vl-3b.purpose: Evaluated model of the frozen ApronLens V2 run; primary backbone for both projects

qwen3-vl-4b.purpose: Next-generation Qwen at a similar size to the evaluated 3B model

qwen3-vl-8b.purpose: Larger Qwen; separates model size from task design

qwen3.5-9b.purpose: Newest natively multimodal Qwen that fits a 48 GB Mac without quantisation

gemma-4-e4b.purpose: Second model family; small enough to consider for on-phone use

apronlens-v2-mps.note: Configuration of the frozen ApronLens V2 evaluation (backend/server.py LocalQwen).

compaction-gaivi-cuda.note: Configuration in the compaction project's scripts/cabin_scene_runner.py on main (read 2026-10-31).

cuda-bfloat16-eager.note: What backbone 1.0.0 chose automatically on NVIDIA GPUs; equivalent to neither evaluated profile.
